summary: Vilas County fire tower site at Crab Lake, listed by the Forest Fire Lookout Association as gone; no second source found.

evidence.supports: listed in Vilas County at 46.21181, -89.74294 as a tower that is gone

notes_for_editor: Only one source supports this record: the FFLA Wisconsin county list. Two searches returned lake pages and no lookout history for Crab Lake; no Forest Lookouts page, register entry or newspaper item was found. The story is well under the 120-word floor because the evidence is that thin. Consider holding publication until a second source turns up, or publishing as a stub.
